newsitem.title: USA: NYC water agency delays sale until at least Thurs.
newsitem.headline: NYC water agency delays sale until at least Thurs.

text.p: The New York City Municipal Water Finance Authority, which has been adjusting the sale date for its $371 million bond sale, said on Tuesday that the sale likely would be delayed until at least Thursday.

"We're definitely not selling tomorrow," said an official with the Authority. "Our expectation is that we will just defer a day and sell it Thursday," he said, adding a final announcement would be made on Wednesday.
The Authority last week had signaled that it might seek to delay the sale until the week of October 21, but it later said it would go ahead with the offering this week.

The uncertainity was due to the Authority's wish to "finish up conversations" with its auditors, as the agency's annual audit is released around the same time, said the city official, who spoke on condition of anonymity.
